file: 337 The Arcade Game That Vanished in 1981 Part 2.mp4

lines.t: Part 2. Polybius vanished. But real things happened in Portland in 1981.

full.credit: Clips: Push Square; Nostalgia Nerd; Gaming Historian (YouTube)

lines.t: A teenager got a migraine playing Tempest, and was found passed out in a stranger's yard.

full.credit: Clips: Push Square; Nostalgia Nerd; Gaming Historian (YouTube)

lines.t: Another kid played Asteroids for 28 hours straight for a record, and got sick.

full.credit: Clips: Push Square; Nostalgia Nerd; Gaming Historian (YouTube)

lines.t: Ten days later, the FBI raided Portland arcades. Agents watched the machines and wrote down high scores.

full.credit: Clips: Push Square; Nostalgia Nerd; Gaming Historian (YouTube)

lines.t: They were hunting illegal gambling machines. So the men in black were real. Just not who people thought.

full.credit: Clips: Push Square; Nostalgia Nerd; Gaming Historian (YouTube)

lines.t: And Polybius? No 1980s newspaper ever mentioned it. The first trace is a website note around 2000. Anyone heard of this game?

full.credit: Clips: Push Square; Nostalgia Nerd; Gaming Historian (YouTube)
